title: Renewed U.S.-Iran tension could push oil past $100: Rapidan Energy
summary: The renewed tensions between the U.S. and Iran have raised concerns about potential disruptions in oil supply, leading to predictions of increased prices. Bob McNally, an expert in energy markets, forecasts that both Brent and West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures could surpass the $100 mark. This escalation in oil prices could have significant implications for the global economy, particularly as the midterm elections approach in the U.S.
